citations.claim: pre-impact inbound speed ~18.34 downward just before floor contact
post-impact outbound speed ~28.96 upward, far larger than e=0.5 bounce should give
total energy jumps from ~176J to ~427J across the single floor-contact step

counterfactual.change: Set initial vy from -17.74 to 0 (one field) so the body never reaches the floor within 91 steps; no impact occurs and energy stays conserved.

explanation: Single ball dropped from y=1.9 hits arena floor at step 91. Inbound speed ~18.34 with e=0.5 should rebound at ~9.2, but rebounds at ~28.96, more than tripling kinetic energy (176J -> 427J). With e=0 the same impact still rebounds at ~19.79 upward (gain vs 18.34 inbound), proving the floor contact solver (impulse + positional correction snapping y to exactly r) injects energy on a penetrating high-speed contact rather than dissipating it.
vision_note: A single blue ball drops vertically toward the bottom arena wall across steps 88 to 90 and makes floor contact at step 91. No rebound is visible in the strip because the tiles after step 91 are blank, so the claimed energetic bounce cannot be seen.
